messages:
Maria Chen: Quick heads-up — kicking off canary for release v2.3.1 in 10m. Please run the SLO preflight and watch the embeddings route p95 & 5xx. @Anita @Tyler
DeployBot: [bot] Canary scheduled: v2.3.1 -> service/inference. Initial canary 5% starting at 6135802468. Commit: 9f3b7a2. Commands: /rollback <commit> | /pin <route>=<version>
Anita Patel: On it — doing traces + error sampling now. Where's the runbook link?
Maria Chen: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-sentinel (internal only) :eyes:
ObservabilityBot: SLO snapshot (last 15m): p50=42ms, p95=285ms (↑40ms), errors(5xx)=0.30% (↑0.20%). Thresholds: p95>250ms or errors>0.20% => flagged. Anomaly detected on route=embeds. Auto-note added.
Tyler Nguyen: I see a small p95 blip too. Pulling traces for 12:10-12:14 window. Might be kvcache GC.
Priya Rao: running quick group query: ```bash
haystack query --service inference --range 15m --agg p95 --group route
```
Priya Rao: output snippet: embeds-route p95=310ms, rerank p95=120ms.
Anita Patel: Traces point to embedding backend calling a remote KMS for key unwrap — redis GETs also have a longer tail. KMS retries upscoped around 12:11.
Maria Chen: Ok let's hold the canary at 5% and do NOT ramp. Two options: rollback full release or route-level pin for embeds back to v2.3.0. Thoughts?
Tyler Nguyen: I'll try a route-level pin first. Less blast radius. Command I will run: `/deploybot pin route=embeds version=2.3.0`
DeployBot: Command received: pin route=embeds -> 2.3.0. Applying pin; canary remains at 5%. 
ObservabilityBot: New SLO snapshot (last 5m) AFTER pin: embeds-route p95=128ms, errors(5xx)=0.08%. Metrics improved.
Maria Chen: Good catch everyone. Keep the pin for 20m and continuous watch on p95/errors. @SRE oncall please keep eyes on traces and KMS metrics.
Anita Patel: I'll capture this in the release notes under 'canary incident' and add follow-up action items (KMS retry handling, redis timeouts). :memo:
DeployBot: Canary progression paused. Next steps: resume when leads ack and metrics stable for 20m. Use /deploybot resume <canary-id> when ready. :rotating_light:
Maria Chen: Acknowledged. We'll reconvene if any regression, otherwise schedule a controlled ramp after 20m. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
